title.rendered: First Aid Kits for Cabo Adventures: Off-Roading, Hiking, and Beach Days

content.rendered:
Cabo’s not just beaches and resorts. Off-roading in the desert, hiking Mount Solmar, ATV trips through the dunes, mountain biking near Sierra de la Laguna — adventure is built into the landscape. Bring a kit.

The Cabo Adventure First-Aid Essentials

  • Sterile gauze, bandaids, and adhesive tape
  • Antiseptic wipes and medication ointment
  • Hydrocortisone cream
  • Ace bandage
  • Tweezers (for cactus spines, no joke)
  • Electrolyte packets
  • Sunscreen and lip balm with SPF
  • Ibuprofen and Tylenol
  • Antihistamines
  • Reusable cold pack

Pre-Built Kits Available

We sell pre-built adventure kits at our store and via delivery. Tell us your activity (off-road, snorkel, hike, sportfishing) and we’ll customize.

Hotel Pickup Spots

Adventure travelers often stay at The Cape Thompson, Solaz Marriott, Hilton Los Cabos, or remote villas in Cabo Pulmo. We deliver to all of it.

+52 624 226 1023 for delivery. Plaza Gali, Local 048, daily 8 AM to 6 PM.

title.rendered: Asthma Care in Cabo: Inhalers, Allergens, and How to Breathe Easy on Vacation

content.rendered:
Cabo’s desert climate is gorgeous but it can be tough on lungs — dry air, occasional dust storms, and the high pollen counts in winter can trigger asthma even in folks who rarely have symptoms back home.

Pack Smart

Bring two inhalers — one for daily use, one as a backup. Pack a peak flow meter if you use one. If you take a daily controller med, don’t skip doses while traveling.

Common Triggers in Cabo

Wind kicking up dust on Medano Beach, scented candles at Las Ventanas al Paraíso spa rooms, blooming desert plants in spring, and dry hotel air conditioning.

If You Need a Refill

Many common rescue inhalers (albuterol/Ventolin) are available at Mexican pharmacies. Bring your bottle for matching. We can deliver to Hyatt Ziva, Le Blanc, Hilton Los Cabos, or any other major resort.

Reach Us

WhatsApp +52 624 226 1023 or visit Plaza Gali, Local 048, daily 8 AM to 6 PM. We’ll help you find what you need quick.

Related Pharmacy Delivery Topics in Cabo San Lucas

Topics covered: asthma cabo, inhaler delivery cabo, albuterol cabo, ventolin mexico, asthma triggers cabo, and more. CVU Pharmacy serves all major hotels and resorts across Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, and the Tourist Corridor.

Service Area: Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, Pedregal, Palmilla, the Corridor, and yacht/villa addresses across Baja California Sur.

Contact: Visit us at Plaza Gali, Local 048, Blvd. Paseo de la Marina 869, Cabo San Lucas, B.C.S. — open 8 AM to 6 PM daily. Call or WhatsApp +52 624 226 1023 for 24/7 delivery.

title.rendered: Cruise Stop in Cabo? How to Find a Pharmacy Fast Without Missing the Ship

content.rendered:
Cruise stops in Cabo are notoriously short — usually 8 to 10 hours, tender in, tender back. If you need pharmacy stuff, you can’t waste time wandering. Here’s the move.

Where to Go (Walking Distance from Tender)

Cruise tenders drop you at the Cabo Marina. From there, our store is a 5-minute walk: Plaza Gali, Local 048, Blvd. Paseo de la Marina 869. You won’t even break a sweat.

What Cruise Passengers Usually Need

Sea-Bands or seasickness meds, sunscreen, blister bandages from those cobblestone shore excursions, ibuprofen, allergy meds, and the occasional emergency Imodium. We have all of it stocked and ready.

In and Out in 10 Minutes

We move fast. English-speaking staff, accept USD, MXN, and major credit cards. No language games, no haggling, no mystery prices.

Need Delivery to the Pier?

Some cruise passengers prefer delivery to a beach club like Office on the Beach, Mango Deck, or even right to the marina. Just WhatsApp +52 624 226 1023 and we’ll meet you wherever.

Hours

Open 8 AM to 6 PM, 7 days a week. Cruise day or not, we’re here.

title.rendered: Diabetes Travelers: Insulin and Supplies in Cabo Made Simple

content.rendered:
Managing diabetes on vacation takes planning, but Cabo is way more manageable than most international trips. Here’s the rundown for traveling with insulin, test strips, and the gear you need.

Bring More Than You Think You’ll Need

Pack at least 50% extra insulin, test strips, lancets, and pump supplies — flight delays happen, beach days get extended, and Murphy’s Law is real on vacation.

Insulin Storage Tips

Cabo gets HOT. Use insulated cases like Frio or Medicool, and keep insulin in your hotel mini-fridge between uses. Most resorts — Marquis, Hyatt Ziva, Hilton Los Cabos — have proper fridges in every suite.

Local Refills

Need a refill in a pinch? CVU Pharmacy stocks common insulins (Lantus, Humalog, Novolog) and supplies. Bring your prescription bottle for verification. Mexican prices on insulin are often noticeably lower than US cash prices.

Emergency Help

If you’re running low at midnight, we deliver 24/7. Call +52 624 226 1023. We’ll bring it to your room at Le Blanc, Pueblo Bonito Pacifica, Esperanza Auberge, or wherever you’re staying.

Visit the Store

Plaza Gali, Local 048, open daily 8 AM to 6 PM. Bring a list of your supplies and we’ll match you up.

title.rendered: What to Do When You Get Sick in Cabo: A Tourist’s Step-by-Step Game Plan

content.rendered:
Getting sick on vacation is the worst. But Cabo actually has a solid healthcare scene — way better than most tourist destinations — and there’s a clear path to feeling better quick. Here’s the playbook.

Step 1: Identify the Severity

Mild stuff (cold, mild stomach issues, minor sunburn) → handle it with OTC meds and rest. Moderate stuff (high fever, persistent vomiting, severe pain) → see a doctor. Emergencies (chest pain, breathing trouble, serious injuries) → go straight to a hospital.

Step 2: Use Your Hotel Resources

Most major resorts — Hilton Los Cabos, Marquis, Grand Solmar, Hyatt Ziva — have on-call doctors who do room visits. Cost is way less than US urgent care.

Step 3: Get Meds Delivered

Once you have a diagnosis, CVU Pharmacy delivers prescriptions and OTC meds in 45 to 60 minutes. WhatsApp +52 624 226 1023.

Step 4: Hospitals If Needed

Cabo’s main hospitals — H+ Los Cabos and Saint Luke’s — both have English-speaking staff and accept many international insurance plans.

We’re Always Here

Plaza Gali, Local 048, daily 8 AM to 6 PM, plus 24/7 delivery.

title.rendered: Pet Pharmacy Needs in Cabo: For Travelers Who Brought Their Furry Co-Pilot

content.rendered:
More travelers are bringing pets to Cabo than ever — pet-friendly resorts like Hotel El Ganzo, The Cape Thompson, and many private villas welcome four-legged guests. But what if Fluffy needs something?

Common Pet Needs We Handle

Flea and tick prevention, basic wound care, mild antihistamines (with vet guidance on dosing), eye drops, ear cleaners, and probiotics for tummy issues. We can also coordinate with local English-speaking vets for prescriptions.

Heat Safety for Pets

Cabo’s pavement gets brutal in summer. Pet booties, cooling vests, and proper hydration matter. Walks should be early morning or after sunset. Pack pet sunscreen for short-haired breeds.

Vet Coordination

Need a vet referral? We work with respected clinics in San José and Cabo San Lucas that handle expat and traveler pets all the time.

Hotels and Villas We Deliver To

Pet-friendly stays we hit regularly: The Cape Thompson Hotel, Hotel El Ganzo, Villa La Estancia, plus dozens of private villas. WhatsApp +52 624 226 1023 or visit Plaza Gali, Local 048.

title.rendered: Vitamins, Supplements, and Wellness Stuff: What’s Actually Worth Buying in Cabo

content.rendered:
Cabo’s wellness scene has exploded. From green smoothies in San José to IV drip clinics in the Corridor, it’s a whole vibe. But what about the supplements you’d grab at GNC back home?

What’s Solid in Mexican Pharmacies

Vitamin C, B-complex, melatonin, magnesium, electrolyte powders, probiotics, and basic multivitamins are widely available and generally well-priced. Brands like Genoma Lab, Pisa, and Nature’s Bounty show up regularly.

Stuff to Be Picky About

Imported American brands sometimes get marked up hard, and some “wellness” stores in tourist zones sell low-quality knock-offs. Stick to legit pharmacies for anything you’re putting in your body.

Wellness Resort Guests

If you’re at Las Ventanas al Paraíso, Esperanza Auberge, Montage Los Cabos, or One&Only Palmilla doing a wellness retreat, we deliver supplements straight to your suite. WhatsApp +52 624 226 1023.

Visit the Store

Or come check out our shelves at Plaza Gali, Local 048, daily 8 AM to 6 PM. We’ll help you find legit stuff for your goals.

title.rendered: Spring Break in Cabo: Pharmacy Hacks That’ll Save Your Whole Trip

content.rendered:
Spring break in Cabo means three things: pool parties at Mango Deck, late nights at El Squid Roe, and at least one questionable decision. The trick to lasting all week without crashing? Smart pharmacy prep.

The Spring Break Survival Stack

Pre-game with electrolytes (Liquid I.V., Pedialyte). Pack ibuprofen and Tums. Stash sunscreen near the door so you actually use it. Throw in some melatonin for crashing during the day. Hangover patches work for some people. Vitamin B-complex doesn’t hurt either.

Group Order Discounts

Rolling deep with your crew? We’ll set up a bulk order for the whole squad — sunscreen, hydration, basics — and deliver it all at once to your hotel or villa. Hit us at +52 624 226 1023.

Top Spring Break Hotels We Deliver To

Riu Santa Fe, Riu Palace Cabo San Lucas, Sandos Finisterra, Cabo Villas Beach Resort, Bahia Hotel & Beach House. We know the lobbies, the bell desks, and how to find your group.

Pop Into Plaza Gali

Daytime pickup at Plaza Gali, Local 048, open 8 AM to 6 PM. AC blasting, English-speaking staff, no judgment about whatever happened last night.

title.rendered: Mosquito Bites and Bug Stings in Cabo: What to Use and What to Skip

content.rendered:
Cabo’s mostly desert, so bug situations aren’t as wild as the Yucatán, but mosquitos still show up — especially at sunset, near the estuary in San José, and during the late summer rainy season. Here’s how to handle it.

Best Repellents

For adults: DEET 20-30% or picaridin. For kids: picaridin or oil of lemon eucalyptus. We carry both Mexican and American brands at our shop.

Already Got Bit?

Hydrocortisone cream, calamine lotion, or an oral antihistamine like Benadryl will calm down the itch fast. For multiple bites or hives spreading wider, oral antihistamines work better than topical creams.

Watch for Scorpions in Villas

If you’re staying in a villa in Pedregal, Palmilla, or remote spots like Cabo Pulmo, shake out shoes and check beds. Scorpion stings in Baja are usually painful but rarely dangerous — but call your villa concierge or our pharmacy for guidance.

Delivery to Hotels

We deliver bug spray and treatment kits to Esperanza Auberge, Chileno Bay Resort, One&Only Palmilla, and beyond. WhatsApp +52 624 226 1023. Or visit Plaza Gali, Local 048, daily 8 AM to 6 PM.

title.rendered: Reef-Safe Sunscreen in Cabo: Where to Find It and Why It Actually Matters

content.rendered:
Heads up, beach lovers: Mexico’s marine parks have rules about sunscreen, and Cabo Pulmo (a UNESCO site about an hour up the coast) is super strict. Even on Lover’s Beach and Santa Maria, choosing reef-safe is the right call.

What “Reef-Safe” Actually Means

Skip anything with oxybenzone, octinoxate, octocrylene, or parabens. These chemicals are linked to coral bleaching. Look for mineral sunscreens with zinc oxide or titanium dioxide as the active ingredient.

Brands We Stock

We carry reef-safe options from Sun Bum (mineral line), Stream2Sea, Thinksport, Blue Lizard, and a few solid Mexican brands like Soleo Organics that work great and won’t kill your wallet.

Snorkel Trip Specials

Heading to Cabo Pulmo, Santa Maria, or Chileno Bay for a snorkel day? Order ahead and we’ll deliver to your hotel — Esperanza Auberge, Chileno Bay Resort, Solaz Marriott, or Hilton Los Cabos — before you head out.

Pick Up at Plaza Gali

Or grab some on your way to the boat at Plaza Gali, Local 048, open 8 AM to 6 PM. Delivery 24/7 at +52 624 226 1023.

title.rendered: Cabo Wedding Guest Guide: Pharmacy Essentials for Destination Wedding Weekends

content.rendered:
Destination weddings in Cabo are stunning — sunsets over Sunset Monalisa, ceremonies at Esperanza Auberge, receptions at Flora Farms. But the weekend is a marathon, and your body needs backup.

What to Pack Before the Welcome Dinner

Tums and Pepto for the rich Mexican food. Ibuprofen for tequila headaches. Blister bandages (heels on cobblestone in San José = brutal). Visine for the photos. Allergy meds in case the bride’s bouquet hits different.

Day-of Wedding Survival

Hydration packs, melatonin for jet-lagged guests, double-sided tape for wardrobe malfunctions, deodorant wipes, and definitely a hangover kit for Sunday morning brunch.

Where We Deliver to Wedding Hotels

Big wedding venues we serve regularly: One&Only Palmilla, The Cape Thompson Hotel, Las Ventanas al Paraíso, Garza Blanca Resort, and Solaz Marriott. WhatsApp +52 624 226 1023 for fast delivery.

Visit Us Before the Big Day

Wedding party stocking up? Stop by Plaza Gali, Local 048, 8 AM to 6 PM daily. We’ll help you build a complete kit for the whole bridal party.

content.rendered:
The dress is bought, the matching swimsuits are packed, and the playlist is already a vibe. But every bachelorette trip to Cabo eventually hits that moment when somebody needs something — and nobody wants to leave the pool to get it.

The Bachelorette Pharmacy Survival Kit

Plan B (just in case), feminine care products, condoms, hangover recovery kits for every girl, electrolyte packets, sunscreen reapplications, lip balm with SPF, hair ties, melatonin (for the early flight back), and definitely some Imodium.

Discreet Delivery to Your Villa

Most bachelorette parties book private villas in Pedregal, Palmilla, or San José. We deliver discreetly to villa addresses — no labels, no judgment, no questions asked. Just message +52 624 226 1023.

Resort Bachelorettes

If your squad is at Le Blanc Spa Resort, Hard Rock Hotel Los Cabos, Riu Palace, or Breathless Cabo San Lucas, we’ll meet you at the lobby or have it sent up to your suite.

Plaza Gali Pickup

Doing a girls’ day downtown? Stop by our store at Plaza Gali, Local 048, open daily 8 AM to 6 PM. Right by the marina, AC-cold, and quick.

title.rendered: What’s the Deal with Mexican Pharmacy Prices? A Straight-Up Guide for Americans

content.rendered:
You’ve probably heard rumors that meds are way cheaper in Mexico. Sometimes that’s true. Sometimes it’s not. Let’s break it down without the marketing fluff.

What’s Cheaper in Cabo

Generally: medications, some medication essentials (especially brand-name stuff that’s pricey in the US), birth control pills, and certain dermatology products. Generic OTC items like ibuprofen and antacids often run a few bucks less.

What’s About the Same (Or Even Pricier)

Imported American brands like Pepto-Bismol, Tylenol, or Advil sometimes cost more here because of import fees. Sunscreen with American branding? Yeah, it can sting your wallet at tourist-zone shops.

How to Avoid Tourist Pricing

Skip the pharmacies right next to the cruise pier — they jack prices for foot traffic. Instead, head to Plaza Gali or ask your concierge at the Hilton Los Cabos, Marquis, or Grand Solmar for a recommendation. They send guests to spots with fair pricing.

Honest Pricing, Always

At CVU Pharmacy we post real prices, take USD or MXN at the going rate, and never charge a “gringo tax.” Visit us at Plaza Gali, Local 048 or order delivery at +52 624 226 1023.

title.rendered: Why English-Speaking Pharmacies Are a Game Changer for American Travelers in Cabo

content.rendered:
You’ve been there. You walk into a farmacia, point vaguely at your stomach, and try to remember the word for “diarrhea” while the pharmacist stares at you politely. It’s awkward, it’s slow, and it’s no way to spend your vacation. Good news: it doesn’t have to be that way in Cabo.

Real English Service, Not Google Translate

Every CVU Pharmacy team member speaks fluent English. We can talk through symptoms, dosages, ingredients, drug interactions, and any concerns about meds you’re already taking back home. No charades required.

We Get the American Brand Names

Tylenol = Tempra. Advil = ibuprofeno. Pepto = Pepto (some things don’t need translating). We know the equivalents and we’ll match you with the right product, even if the box looks different than what you’d find at Walgreens.

Hotel Concierges Recommend Us

Concierges at the Waldorf Astoria Pedregal, One&Only Palmilla, Esperanza Auberge, and Montage Los Cabos often send guests our way because they know we won’t leave anyone confused or overcharged.

Visit or Call

Plaza Gali, Local 048, Blvd. Paseo de la Marina 869, Cabo San Lucas — open 8 AM to 6 PM. Delivery 24/7 at +52 624 226 1023.

title.rendered: Allergic Reaction in Cabo? Here’s Your Quick-Action Plan (Plus Antihistamine Delivery)

content.rendered:
Vacation allergies sneak up out of nowhere. Maybe it’s a shrimp at the resort buffet, an unfamiliar plant on a hike near Mount Solmar, or a bug bite that swelled way more than it should have. Whatever it is, you need a game plan.

What to Do First

For mild reactions — itchy skin, sneezing, hives — pop an oral antihistamine like Benadryl, Claritin, or Zyrtec. For localized swelling or rashes, hydrocortisone cream helps a ton. Always read the dosing on the box.

When It’s an Emergency

Trouble breathing, swelling of the face or throat, dizziness — that’s anaphylaxis territory. Use your EpiPen if you have one and head straight to H+ Hospital or Saint Luke’s in Cabo. Don’t mess around.

We Carry the Allergy Essentials

Benadryl, Claritin, Zyrtec, hydrocortisone cream, calamine lotion, saline nasal sprays — all in stock at our pharmacy. Delivery to Le Blanc Spa Resort, Garza Blanca, Pueblo Bonito Pacifica, or anywhere else in Cabo runs about 45 to 60 minutes.

Reach Out

WhatsApp +52 624 226 1023 or visit us at Plaza Gali, Local 048, daily 8 AM to 6 PM.

title.rendered: Traveling to Cabo with Kids? Here’s the Family Pharmacy Checklist Every Parent Needs

content.rendered:
Traveling with kiddos turns every trip into a logistics puzzle. Forget one thing and the whole vacation can derail. Whether you’re posted up at the Hyatt Ziva Los Cabos (one of the best family resorts in town) or a villa in San José, here’s the parental cheat sheet.

The Cabo Family Pharmacy Checklist

  • Children’s Tylenol and Motrin (liquid form)
  • Pedialyte popsicles or packets
  • Mineral-based sunscreen for sensitive skin
  • Bug spray (kid-safe formula)
  • Saline nasal spray
  • Bandaids in fun designs
  • Diapers, wipes, swim diapers
  • Baby formula and snacks
  • Antihistamines (kid dose)
  • Thermometer

Family-Friendly Hotels We Deliver To

title.rendered: Hangover Recovery Delivery in Cabo: The Morning-After Survival Guide

content.rendered:
It seemed like a great idea at midnight. The tequila flights at Cabo Wabo, the dance floor at El Squid Roe, that late-night pizza on the way home. Now it’s 9 AM, your head is pounding, and even the AC sounds loud. We feel you.

The Tried-and-True Hangover Kit

Pedialyte or Liquid I.V. (this is non-negotiable). Ibuprofen or Excedrin. Tums for the stomach situation. A Gatorade or coconut water for backup hydration. Anti-nausea meds if you’re really struggling. Toss in some B-vitamins if you wanna feel human by lunch.

Delivery to Every Party Hotel in Cabo

We’ve made hangover deliveries to basically every resort in town — Hard Rock Hotel Los Cabos, Riu Santa Fe, Cabo Villas Beach Resort, The Cape, a Thompson Hotel, you name it. Average delivery time: 45 minutes. WhatsApp us at +52 624 226 1023.

Pro Tip: Pre-Order Before You Go Out

The smart move? Order your hangover kit before you hit the bars. Stash it in the minibar fridge so it’s ready when future-you crawls back in.

Or Pop Into Plaza Gali

If you can manage the walk, we’re at Plaza Gali, Local 048, open daily 8 AM to 6 PM.

Spoiler: it’s mostly aloe vera, sunscreen reapplications, melatonin, allergy meds, and the occasional electrolyte pack. We also bring spa-friendly stuff like rosewater spray, lip balm, and after-sun lotion.

What Belongs in Every Yacht Med Kit

Dramamine or Bonine for seasickness, plus the ginger chews for backup. Reef-safe sunscreen (Cabo banned the bad stuff). Aloe gel. Tylenol and ibuprofen. Bandaids, antiseptic spray, hydrocortisone for jellyfish stings, and electrolyte packs for hangover insurance.

Dockside Delivery Available

We deliver right to the slip at Cabo San Lucas Marina, IGY Marina, and the private docks near Pueblo Bonito Sunset. Just text us your slip number on WhatsApp at +52 624 226 1023 and we’ll be there before your captain finishes the safety briefing.

Same Goes for Sportfishing Charters

Heading out for a marlin run with Pisces or Picante? Same deal — we’ll bring everything to your boat at the marina before sunrise.

We’re literally a 5-minute walk from the marina. Drop by Plaza Gali, Local 048, Blvd. Paseo de la Marina 869 anytime from 8 AM to 6 PM.

title.rendered: Montezuma’s Revenge in Cabo: The Real Talk Guide to Traveler’s Diarrhea

content.rendered:
Look, we’re all adults here. Sometimes the street tacos hit different — and not in a good way. Traveler’s diarrhea (lovingly nicknamed Montezuma’s Revenge by Americans) is the most common health hiccup tourists run into in Mexico. Here’s how to handle it like a champ.

What to Take and When

For mild cases, Pepto-Bismol or bismuth subsalicylate usually does the trick. For something stronger, loperamide (Imodium) slows things down quick. Pair it with electrolyte packs to keep you from getting dehydrated under that Baja sun.

When to Call a Doctor

Blood, high fever, or symptoms lasting more than 48 hours? That’s not gonna fix itself. Most resorts like the Pueblo Bonito Sunset Beach, Hyatt Ziva, and Secrets Puerto Los Cabos have on-call docs — use ’em.

How to Avoid It Next Time

Stick to bottled water, skip the salads at sketchy spots, and ease into the spicy stuff. Probiotics taken before your trip can also help.

We Deliver Relief Fast

Don’t suffer in silence — WhatsApp +52 624 226 1023 and we’ll have a relief kit at your hotel door in 45 minutes flat. Or swing by Plaza Gali, Local 048, open 8 AM to 6 PM daily.

title.rendered: Sunburn SOS: How to Bounce Back After a Day on Medano Beach

content.rendered:
So you went hard on Medano Beach. Maybe you posted up at Mango Deck, downed a few buckets of Pacificos, and totally lost track of time. Now you look like a lobster and your bedsheets feel like sandpaper. Been there.

The 4-Step Sunburn Recovery Combo

1. Cool down. Lukewarm shower, no hot water. 2. Hydrate. Pound electrolytes — coconut water counts too. 3. Aloe + lidocaine gel. Stash it in the minibar fridge first, trust me. 4. Pain relief. Ibuprofen or naproxen will tame the inflammation.

We’ve Got the Whole Sunburn Survival Kit

CVU Pharmacy stocks pure aloe vera, after-sun lotion, lidocaine spray, ibuprofen, and proper hydration packs. We’ll deliver the whole kit to your room at Bahia Hotel, Cabo Villas Beach Resort, ME Cabo, or wherever you’re crashing.

When to See a Doctor

If you’re blistering, dizzy, or running a fever, that’s heat exhaustion territory — call your hotel doc immediately. We can also hook you up with a referral.

Visit our store at Plaza Gali, Blvd. Paseo de la Marina 869, or hit us on WhatsApp at +52 624 226 1023 for delivery in 45 minutes.

title.rendered: Top 10 Things American Tourists Always Forget to Pack for Cabo (We’ve Got ‘Em All)

content.rendered:
You packed the swim trunks. You packed the GoPro. You even remembered the phone charger. But somewhere between TSA and your suite at the Montage Los Cabos, half your toiletries went MIA. We see this every single day.

The Top 10 Forgotten Items in Cabo

  1. Sunscreen — Cabo sun is no joke. SPF 50 minimum, y’all.
  2. Aloe vera gel — for when you ignored the SPF advice.
  3. Imodium / Pepto-Bismol — the classic traveler’s tummy combo.
  4. Electrolyte packs — Pedialyte, Liquid I.V., the works.
  5. Allergy meds — Claritin, Zyrtec, Benadryl.
  6. Motion sickness pills — for those Cabo Adventures snorkel trips.
  7. Bug spray — especially if you’re heading to Todos Santos.
  8. Contact solution — always forgotten, always needed.
  9. Feminine care products — because surprises happen.
  10. Hangover recovery kit — Cabo nightlife is undefeated.

We Deliver to Every Resort in Cabo

Whether you’re at Esperanza Auberge Resort, One&Only Palmilla, or a budget-friendly spot on Medano, we’ll bring it all to your door in under an hour. WhatsApp +52 624 226 1023.

Or Drop By Plaza Gali

Need it now? Our Plaza Gali, Local 048 store is right by the marina. Open 8 AM to 6 PM daily.

title.rendered: 24/7 Pharmacy Delivery in Cabo: Why Late-Night Sickness Is No Big Deal Anymore

content.rendered:
It always happens at the worst time, right? You’re tucked into your suite at the Nobu Hotel Los Cabos at 1:47 AM and suddenly your stomach is throwing a full-on rebellion. The mini-bar Tums ain’t cutting it. The hotel gift shop closed hours ago. Now what?

One Call, One Delivery, Zero Drama

CVU Concierge runs delivery 24 hours a day, 7 days a week — yes, even on Sundays, even on Día de los Muertos, even at 3 AM when the only other thing open is the taco stand on Medano Beach. Call +52 624 226 1023 and we’ll have a driver rolling within minutes.

What Folks Order at Weird Hours

Nine times out of ten it’s something like Pepto-Bismol, Imodium, ibuprofen, melatonin (jet lag is brutal), Tylenol PM, or a hangover kit after a wild night at The Office on Medano. Sometimes it’s diapers for tired parents at the Hilton Los Cabos. Whatever you need, no judgment.

Hotels We Hit Up Most

Between midnight and sunrise, our top delivery spots include Sandos Finisterra, RIU Palace Cabo San Lucas, Marquis Los Cabos, and the corridor resorts heading toward San José.

The Physical Store for Daytime Pickups

If you’re already out and about, our shop at Plaza Gali, Blvd. Paseo de la Marina 869 is open daily from 8 AM to 6 PM. Pop in, grab what you need, and bounce.

title.rendered: Cabo San Lucas Pharmacy Delivery: Essentials Brought Right to Your Hotel Door

content.rendered:
Let’s be real — nobody plans on getting sick during a Cabo getaway. You came down here for sunsets at Lover’s Beach, tacos in San José del Cabo, and maybe a margarita (or three) at Cabo Wabo. But sometimes a sunburn flares up, the kids catch a tummy bug, or that buffet last night did you dirty. That’s where CVU Pharmacy swoops in to save your trip.

Pharmacy Delivery Straight to Your Hotel in Cabo

We get it — you didn’t fly all the way to Baja California Sur to spend your afternoon hunting down a farmacia. Whether you’re posted up at the Waldorf Astoria Los Cabos Pedregal, kicking back at the Grand Velas, or chilling at Hard Rock Hotel Los Cabos, our delivery team rolls right up to your lobby (or villa, or yacht slip) in 45 to 60 minutes flat.

What Can You Order from CVU Pharmacy?

Pretty much anything you’d grab at a CVS or Walgreens back home — over-the-counter meds, sunscreen, aloe vera, electrolyte packs, allergy stuff, motion sickness pills for those sportfishing days, baby formula, diapers, feminine care products, and the random toiletries you forgot to pack. We also handle prescriptions when you’ve got a valid one.

Why Travelers Trust CVU Concierge

Our staff speaks English, no awkward Google Translate moments. We take cards, cash (USD or pesos), and we know exactly how to get to every resort from Pedregal to the Corridor to Palmilla. First-time customers snag 10% off, which is honestly a no-brainer.

Visit Our Physical Store at Plaza Gali

If you’re cruising the Marina anyway, swing by our brick-and-mortar spot at Plaza Gali, Local 048, Blvd. Paseo de la Marina 869, Cabo San Lucas. We’re open 8 AM to 6 PM, seven days a week. Delivery, though? That’s 24/7 — because emergencies don’t keep banker’s hours.

Call or WhatsApp Us Anytime

Hit us up at +52 624 226 1023. Don’t tough it out when relief is one text away. Your vacation deserves better than a sick day.

Related Pharmacy Delivery Topics in Cabo San Lucas

Topics covered: cabo san lucas pharmacy delivery, hotel pharmacy delivery cabo, 24/7 pharmacy cabo, english speaking pharmacy cabo, medication delivery los cabos, and more. CVU Pharmacy serves all major hotels and resorts across Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, and the Tourist Corridor.

Service Area: Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, Pedregal, Palmilla, the Corridor, Cabo Pulmo (limited), and yacht/villa addresses across Baja California Sur.

Contact: Visit us at Plaza Gali, Local 048, Blvd. Paseo de la Marina 869, Cabo San Lucas, B.C.S. — open 8 AM to 6 PM daily. Call or WhatsApp +52 624 226 1023 for 24/7 delivery.
